claim.statement: M.53 M2 (the architectural claim that 'the encoder is the single most load-bearing lever in the substrate's reasoning architecture; swapping it modifies every downstream step') is EMPIRICALLY PARTIAL REFUTED by M.56. Per-concept dimension-shuffled encoder produces substantial divergence (walks differ ~25%, phi delta 7× baseline noise) but NOT catastrophic divergence (80% halt-mode agreement, 73% mean walk-Jaccard preserved). The substrate has a concept-set-driven stratum that survives encoder geometry perturbations — likely the Walker step-0 rule (M.46 F1' — picks longest prompt-matching concept on string-length, encoder-independent) plus concept-extraction operating on tokens rather than embeddings.
claim.operationalization:
15 diverse prompts run through two fresh Takwin instances:
  A: default encoder (KimeraCooccurrenceEncoder)
  B: wrapped encoder where every embedding is per-concept dimension-shuffled
    (each concept's 300-dim vector has its dimensions permuted by a hash-
    seeded RNG; preserves unit-vector validity, scrambles geometry).
Per-prompt: capture halt mode, walk (concept set + order), Φ, n_zetetic.
Compute halt-mode agreement rate, walk Jaccard, Φ delta, walk length delta.
claim.h0: M.53 M2 strong version: encoder swap collapses reasoning (Jaccard ~ 0.0-0.3)
claim.h1: M.53 M2 partial: encoder swap perturbs but does not collapse (Jaccard > 0.3)

preregistration.analysis_plan: Per-concept dimension-shuffled encoder A/B comparison; measure halt-mode agreement + walk Jaccard + Φ delta + zetetic delta.

detail.interpretation: 80% of prompts halt the same way under encoder swap — strong preservation
average 73% concept-overlap between A and B walks
7× baseline noise — real signal, but small absolute magnitude
average walk-length change of 1.6 concepts — small
zetetic firing pattern diverges substantially — consistent with encoder being load-bearing for embedding-pair detection (the zetetic mechanism)

detail.hypothesis: Walker step-0 rule (M.46 F1') + concept extraction operate on token strings, encoder-independent; this stratum survives encoder perturbations

verdict.reasoning: Observed walk Jaccard mean 0.731 (median 0.818) — substantially > 0.30 floor. Halt-mode agreement 80% (12/15 prompts halt the same way). Phi delta mean 0.068 — 7× the M.46 F3 baseline noise (0.01) so this IS signal, but absolute value still small (max 0.127). The substrate's reasoning has a layer that operates on CONCEPT IDENTITIES (not encoder embeddings) and that layer survives encoder perturbations. The encoder DOES affect reasoning (n_zetetic delta mean 12.7 is large; phi changes 7× baseline) but it's not the all-determining lever M.53 M2 described.
